_: Shops (workstream SHOPS, design/godot-shops.md). One entry per shop: id, store (the layout's name), title (the screen's heading), attendant (an id in attendants.json), years, greeting (said when the list opens), items [{item (an id in data/items/*.json), price_cents (whole cents), price_note (where the price comes from: Steven, guess, estimate), ready_line (said when it is bought), ready_line_by (Steven, or PLACEHOLDER when it follows his pattern for an item he gave no line for), standin (true: a labelled stand-in model until the real one lands; swap the item id here)}]. Opened by mall.shop.open(shop_id) (scripts/shop.gd). Money: mall.can_afford / mall.spend (design/godot-economy.md). No basket, no leaving check (later). Cuco's (workstream CUCOS, design/godot-cucos.md) joined at int-51; its bartender opens it through scripts/story/bartender.gd.
